newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Endesa to bid for Colombia plant.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Endesa to bid for Colombia plant.

text.p: Chilean power company Endesa Empresa Nacional de Electricidad SA said it will bid together with other Chilean and Colombian firms in the privatization of Colombian utility Empresa Electrica del Pacifico (EPSA).
The consortium includes the much smaller Chilean power firm, Emel and the Colombian company Corfivalle, said the statement.
Bids for EPSA, for which a minimum price of $520 million has been set, will be opened May 16, it said.

"If we win the bid, the group will separte the generation and distribution businesses with the first staying in the hands of Endesa and the second with Emel. Corfivalle will maintain a presence in both companies," said the statement.
Endesa already owns one power plant in Colombia -- the 500 megawatt Betania hydroelectric complex which it bought in December.
